name: identvia/identvia-php
description: Sign in with Identvia for PHP: OpenID Connect with PKCE, state/nonce, ID token validation via cached JWKS, userinfo. Works on plain shared hosting, no framework needed.

suggest.ext-curl: Faster HTTP; the SDK falls back to PHP streams without it
suggest.ext-apcu: Keeps the JWKS/discovery cache in memory instead of files
